name: Surani Steel Tubes Ltd.
summary: Surani Steel Tubes Ltd. is an India-based manufacturer and supplier of Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) Mild Steel (MS) pipes and steel tubes, operating primarily within the steel processing industry. The company's main products include various forms of mild steel pipes such as round, square, rectangular, and structural pipes, as well as mild steel hollow sections and mild steel coils, including hot rolled and slit coils. These products are utilized across diverse sectors including agriculture, construction, chemicals, plumbing, water supply systems, oil and gas transmission, infrastructure, and irrigation. Surani Steel Tubes Ltd. operates with a manufacturing-led business model, procuring raw materials like Hot Rolled Coils and processing them into finished goods at its manufacturing facility located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The company primarily targets the domestic Indian market, leveraging its strategic location for distribution.
